decision.reasoning_trace: In this shopping session, I evaluated several Bluetooth speakers ranging from budget options to premium brand names. My consideration set included the highly-rated JBL Flip 5 and Charge 5, along with mid-range alternatives from comiso, Raymate, and INSMY. While the JBL products have excellent reputations, their price points ($90 to $150) are a significant investment. Conversely, the more affordable 30W speakers like the comiso and Raymate had mixed feedback regarding longevity and out-of-the-box failures. Furthermore, the search results were cluttered with accessories like carrying cases and replacement batteries, which made it harder to find a diverse range of actual hardware. Ultimately, I am not confident enough in the budget brands to risk the purchase, and I am not ready to commit to the higher price of the JBL models today.
